verdict.rationale: Cognee is primarily a memory/knowledge-graph backend that other agents (via MCP) query; it doesn't ship a general in-product chat assistant, but it does offer a CLI that lets you 'ask questions' of memory and an integration that installs Cognee itself as a Linear agent that 'answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory.' missing for 10: a native in-product conversational assistant UI, clear task-delegation workflow beyond a single Linear integration, independent hands-on evidence of delegating open-ended tasks.
